comment: VirtualTerminal screen-state goldens for the pi-tui completion gate (issue #386). Each row pins the deterministic C++ screen state (or forwarded-input outcome) of one scenario and cites the frozen pi test expectation it mirrors (row-by-row TS-side pin, ADR 0035 gate tier 3 fork-B). The C++ side is the executable evidence (VirtualTerminal is the retained protocol-aware harness); the small line arrays here are the committed snapshots the differential test compares byte-for-byte. Scenario renderings are deterministic: fixed dimensions, dummy text only.

scenarios.name: renderer-middle-line-change
scenarios.pi: tui-render.test.ts "renders correctly when only a middle line changes (spinner case)" — the changed middle line updates while the surrounding lines stay (pi asserts viewport[1] contains the new text)

scenarios.name: renderer-last-line-change
scenarios.pi: tui-render.test.ts "renders correctly when last line changes but rest stays same" — the trailing line updates without touching earlier lines

scenarios.name: shrink-to-zero
scenarios.pi: tui-shrink.test.ts "clears all rendered lines when content shrinks to zero" — every previously rendered line is cleared (pi asserts no viewport line contains the old text) (C++ sidecar: shrink-to-zero is reached with line flow, the stale rows are cleared in place to blank cells; ADR 0037 main-screen scrollback flow)

scenarios.name: shrink-to-single-line
scenarios.pi: tui-shrink.test.ts "handles shrink to single line" — rows below the shrunken content are cleared (C++ sidecar: shrink to a single line clears the stale rows in place; ADR 0037 main-screen scrollback flow)

scenarios.name: shrink-clears-trailing-rows
scenarios.pi: tui-render.test.ts "clears empty rows when content shrinks significantly" — first lines preserved, rows after the new content are cleared (pi asserts viewport[2..].trim() is empty)

scenarios.name: cell-size-bare-escape
scenarios.pi: tui-cell-size-input.test.ts "forwards bare escape even when a cell size query was sent at startup" — a lone ESC is not swallowed by the cell-size response consumer (pi asserts recorder.inputs deep-equals ["\u001b"]; the C++ decode-at-edge layer buffers the ambiguous ESC until the fragment flush and then delivers the escape key)

scenarios.name: cell-size-response-consumed
scenarios.pi: tui-cell-size-input.test.ts "consumes cell size responses and still forwards later user input" — the \u001b[6;20;10t response updates the cell dimensions and is not forwarded; later input still arrives (pi asserts recorder.inputs deep-equals [] then ["q"] and getCellDimensions() is {widthPx: 10, heightPx: 20})

scenarios.name: overlay-bottom-right
scenarios.pi: overlay-options.test.ts "should position overlay at bottom-right" — the overlay lands in the bottom-right corner of the terminal

scenarios.name: overlay-top-left
scenarios.pi: overlay-options.test.ts "should position overlay at top-left" — the overlay lands in the top-left corner

scenarios.name: overlay-non-capturing-passthrough
scenarios.pi: overlay-non-capturing.test.ts "non-capturing overlay preserves focus on creation" — a non-capturing overlay does not capture input; the focused base component still receives the key

scenarios.name: component-input-cjk
scenarios.pi: input.test.ts "does not overflow with wide CJK and fullwidth text" — the single-line Input renders horizontally scrolled content whose visible width never exceeds the component width

scenarios.name: component-select-list
scenarios.pi: select-list.test.ts "normalizes multiline descriptions to single line" — multiline descriptions render on one line with the primary label column aligned
expected: A very long primar  second description

scenarios.name: scrollback-full-buffer-write
scenarios.pi: ADR 0037 main-screen scrollback flow — the renderer writes the full composed buffer (no viewport clipping); overflow advances into the terminal's native scrollback. scrollback() ++ screen() is the full written buffer.

scenarios.name: scrollback-viewport-top-tracking
scenarios.pi: ADR 0037 — appending content advances the tracked viewport top over the buffer; the first lines scroll into the terminal's scrollback.

scenarios.name: scrollback-startup-header-scrolls-away
scenarios.pi: ADR 0037 — first render does not clear (pi assumes clean screen), so the startup header/loaded-resources block stays visible at boot; as the buffer grows past one screen the header scrolls away with the flow.

scenarios.name: scrollback-first-render-no-clear
scenarios.pi: ADR 0037 — first render keeps pi's assumes-clean-screen semantics: no clear-screen and no clear-scrollback event; the full buffer is written and overflow scrolls.

scenarios.name: scrollback-resize-clears-screen-and-scrollback
scenarios.pi: ADR 0037 — a height change triggers a full redraw emitting \x1b[2J\x1b[H\x1b[3J (clear screen, home, clear scrollback); reflow starts clean and the terminal's scroll history is cleared, matching pi.

scenarios.name: scrollback-image-follows-content
scenarios.pi: ADR 0037 fork-B interplay — a Terminal-Owned Image Placement keeps its absolute row identity as content grows; the row scrolling into the terminal's scrollback carries its image placement.
